nodes.label: CRM Plan v2
nodes.rationale: Sequences Inbox/Contacts/Pipeline/Leads/Marketing by dependency and actual size rather than treating them as five equal tasks.

nodes.label: Database Enum/Shape as Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: The DB shape wins casing/shape disagreements between UI and schema (with a documented exception when the UI has far more working call sites); picking this once prevents trial-and-error rediscovery.

nodes.label: toClientDTO Response Shaping
nodes.rationale: Maps flat Prisma postCount/lastPostAt columns into the nested posts shape ClientsTable already expects instead of changing every consumer.

nodes.label: Prisma Neon Driver Adapter
nodes.rationale: Function-per-request runtimes exhaust TCP connection limits under load if each invocation opens a plain connection; the adapter is a correctness fix, not platform-specific.

nodes.label: Prisma CLI Stable Pin (7.10.0)
nodes.rationale: prisma CLI was pinned to 7.10.0 to match @prisma/client; the 8.0.0-rc.17 pre-release lacks a generate command.

nodes.label: DB-backed SystemState Dry-Run Toggle
nodes.rationale: Dry-run/safety state moved from a module-level let to a singleton DB row because stateless runtimes do not guarantee memory persistence between invocations; this toggle gates simulated vs live posting.

nodes.label: Inbox Gated on Platform Adapters
nodes.rationale: Inbox needs real platform API connections; a mocked inbox with no data source looks done and is worse than not building it, so it is sequenced after Pipeline/Leads.
